notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Morgue Toad with haste.
Activate the Morgue Toad token by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
When the Morgue Toad token dies, Saheeli triggers, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.
